terms.gloss: an adulterer; the lover of a married woman
evidence: Plaut. Amph. 1049: sīve uxōrem sīve adulterum
terms.comment: The woman is adultera (Hor. C. 3.3.25, Lewis & Short); the offence, adulterium.

terms.gloss: an adulterer, a chaser of other men’s wives
terms.register: vōx cōmica et satirica: Plaut., Ter.; Hor., Juv.
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 775: Erus meus ita magnus moechus mulierum est

phrases.latin: Erus meus ita magnus moechus mulierum est, ut nēminem fuisse aequē neque futūrum crēdō.
phrases.english: My master is such a great chaser of women that I believe he never had his equal and never will.

sources: Lewis & Short: adulter · Lewis & Short: moechus
